pairs: Blessed are the immaculate in the way,
who walk in the law of the Lord.
Blessed are those who examine his testimonies.
They seek him with their whole heart.
Non enim qui operantur iniquitatem in viis ejus ambulaverunt.
For those who work iniquity have not walked in his ways.
Tu mandasti mandata tua custodiri nimis.
You have ordered your commandments to be kept most diligently.
Utinam dirigantur viæ meæ ad custodiendas justificationes tuas.
I wish that my ways may be directed so as to keep your justifications.
Then I will not be confounded,
cum perspexero in omnibus mandatis tuis.
when I will look into all your commandments.
I will confess to you with honesty of heart.
in eo quod didici judicia justitiæ tuæ.
In this way, I have learned the judgments of your justice.
In quo corrigit adolescentior viam suam?
By what does an adolescent correct his way?
In toto corde meo exquisivi te;
With my whole heart, I have sought you.
ne repellas me a mandatis tuis.
Do not let me be driven away from your commandments.
In corde meo abscondi eloquia tua,
I have hidden your eloquence in my heart,
so that I may not sin against you.
In labiis meis pronuntiavi omnia judicia oris tui.
With my lips, I have pronounced all the judgments of your mouth.
In via testimoniorum tuorum delectatus sum,
I have been delighted in the way of your testimonies,
I will be trained in your commandments,
and I will consider your ways.
I will meditate on your justifications.
I will not forget your words.
and I will keep your words.
et considerabo mirabilia de lege tua.
and I will consider the wonders of your law.
I am a sojourner on the earth.
non abscondas a me mandata tua.
Do not hide your commandments from me.
Concupivit anima mea desiderare justificationes tuas in omni tempore.
My soul has longed to desire your justifications at all times.
maledicti qui declinant a mandatis tuis.
Those who decline from your commandments are accursed.
Aufer a me opprobrium et contemptum,
Take me away from disgrace and contempt,
for I have sought your testimonies.
servus autem tuus exercebatur in justificationibus tuis.
But your servant has been trained in your justifications.
Nam et testimonia tua meditatio mea est,
For your testimonies are also my meditation,
and your justifications are my counsel.
My soul has adhered to the pavement.
Revive me according to your word.
Instruct me in the way of your justifications,
and I will be trained in your wonders.
My soul has slumbered because of weariness.
Remove the way of iniquity from me,
et de lege tua miserere mei.
and have mercy on me by your law.
I have chosen the way of truth.
I have not forgotten your judgments.
I have adhered to your testimonies,
Do not be willing to confound me.
I have run by way of your commandments,
and I will always inquire into it.
and I will examine your law.
et custodiam illam in toto corde meo.
And I will keep it with my whole heart.
Deduc me in semitam mandatorum tuorum,
Lead me according to the path of your commandments,
Inclina cor meum in testimonia tua,
Bend my heart with your testimonies,
lest they see what is vain.
Statue servo tuo eloquium tuum in timore tuo.
Station your eloquence with your servant, along with your fear.
Amputa opprobrium meum quod suspicatus sum,
Cut off my disgrace, which I have taken up,
Behold, I have longed for your commandments.
Et veniat super me misericordia tua,
And let your mercy overwhelm me,
your salvation according to your eloquence.
And I will respond to those who reproach me by word,
for I have hoped in your words.
Et ne auferas de ore meo verbum veritatis usquequaque,
And do not utterly take away the word of truth from my mouth.
For in your judgments, I have hoped beyond hope.
And I will always keep your law,
in sæculum et in sæculum sæculi.
in this age and forever and ever.
And I have wandered far and wide,
because I was seeking your commandments.
Et loquebar in testimoniis tuis in conspectu regum,
And I spoke of your testimonies in the sight of kings,
And I meditated on your commandments,
Et levavi manus meas ad mandata tua,
And I lifted up my hands to your commandments,
And I was trained in your justifications.
Memor esto verbi tui servo tuo,
Be mindful of your word to your servant,
by which you have given me hope.
Hæc me consolata est in humilitate mea,
This has consoled me in my humiliation,
for your word has revived me.
a lege autem tua non declinavi.
but I have not turned aside from your law.
Memor fui judiciorum tuorum a sæculo,
I called to mind your judgments of antiquity,
Faintness has taken hold of me,
because of the sinners, those who abandon your law.
Cantabiles mihi erant justificationes tuæ in loco peregrinationis meæ.
Your justifications were the subject of my worthy singing, in the place of my pilgrimage.
Memor fui nocte nominis tui, Domine,
During the night, I remembered your name,
O Lord, and I kept your law.
Hæc facta est mihi, quia justificationes tuas exquisivi.
This has happened to me because I sought your justifications.
I have said that I would keep your law.
Deprecatus sum faciem tuam in toto corde meo;
I have beseeched your face with my whole heart.
Be merciful to me according to your word.
et converti pedes meos in testimonia tua.
and I have turned my feet toward your testimonies.
and I have not been disturbed,
so that I may keep your commandments.
The ropes of the impious have encircled me,
et legem tuam non sum oblitus.
and I have not forgotten your law.
Media nocte surgebam ad confitendum tibi,
I arose in the middle of the night to confess to you,
over the judgments of your justification.
Particeps ego sum omnium timentium te,
I am a partaker with all those who fear you
You have done well with your servant,
for I have trusted your commandments.
Before I was humbled, I committed offenses;
because of this, I have kept to your word.
et in bonitate tua doce me justificationes tuas.
so in your goodness teach me your justifications.
Multiplicata est super me iniquitas superborum;
The iniquity of the arrogant has been multiplied over me.
ego autem in toto corde meo scrutabor mandata tua.
Yet I will examine your commandments with all my heart.
Coagulatum est sicut lac cor eorum;
Their heart has been curdled like milk.
ego vero legem tuam meditatus sum.
Truly, I have meditated on your law.
It is good for me that you humbled me,
so that I may learn your justifications.
The law of your mouth is good for me,
beyond thousands of gold and silver pieces.
and I will learn your commandments.
Those who fear you will see me,
For I have greatly hoped in your words.
et in veritate tua humiliasti me.
And in your truth, you have humbled me.
Fiat misericordia tua ut consoletur me,
Let it be your mercy that consoles me,
according to your eloquence to your servant.
Let your compassion draw near to me,
quia lex tua meditatio mea est.
For your law is my meditation.
quia injuste iniquitatem fecerunt in me;
for unjustly they have done iniquity to me.
ego autem exercebor in mandatis tuis.
But I will be trained in your commandments.
Let those who fear you turn to me,
along with those who know your testimonies.
Fiat cor meum immaculatum in justificationibus tuis,
Let my heart be immaculate in your justifications,
so that I may not be confounded.
Defecit in salutare tuum anima mea,
My soul has faltered in your salvation,
yet in your word, I have hoped beyond hope.
Defecerunt oculi mei in eloquium tuum,
My eyes have failed in your eloquence,
Quia factus sum sicut uter in pruina;
For I have become like a wineskin in the frost.
I have not forgotten your justifications.
How many are the days of your servant?
quando facies de persequentibus me judicium?
When will you bring judgment against those who persecute me?
The iniquitous have spoken fables to me.
But these are unlike your law.
They have been persecuting me unjustly:
They have nearly consumed me on earth.
ego autem non dereliqui mandata tua.
Yet I have not forsaken your commandments.
Revive me according to your mercy.
And I will keep the testimonies of your mouth.
your word remains firm in heaven,
In generationem et generationem veritas tua;
Your truth is from generation to generation.
By your ordinance, the day perseveres.
For all things are in service to you.
Nisi quod lex tua meditatio mea est,
If your law had not been my meditation,
tunc forte periissem in humilitate mea.
then perhaps I would have perished in my humiliation.
In æternum non obliviscar justificationes tuas,
I will not forget your justifications, for eternity.
For by them, you have enlivened me.
For I have inquired into your justifications.
Me exspectaverunt peccatores ut perderent me;
The sinners have waited for me, in order to destroy me.
I have seen the end of the consummation of all things.
How have I loved your law,
It is my meditation all day long.
Super inimicos meos prudentem me fecisti mandato tuo,
By your commandment, you have made me able to see far, beyond my enemies.
For it is with me for eternity.
I have understood beyond all my teachers.
quia testimonia tua meditatio mea est.
For your testimonies are my meditation.
I have understood beyond the elders.
For I have searched your commandments.
Ab omni via mala prohibui pedes meos,
I have prohibited my feet from every evil way,
so that I may keep your words.
I have not declined from your judgments,
because you have stationed a law for me.
Quam dulcia faucibus meis eloquia tua!
How sweet is your eloquence to my palate,
more so than honey to my mouth!
I obtained understanding by your commandments.
Because of this, I have hated every way of iniquity.
Your word is a lamp to my feet
and a light to my paths.
et statui custodire judicia justitiæ tuæ.
and so I am determined to keep the judgments of your justice.
Revive me according to your word.
Make the willing offerings of my mouth well pleasing,
Anima mea in manibus meis semper,
My soul is always in my hands,
et legem tuam non sum oblitus.
and I have not forgotten your law.
Sinners have set a snare for me,
et de mandatis tuis non erravi.
yet I have not strayed from your commandments.
Hæreditate acquisivi testimonia tua in æternum,
I have acquired your testimonies as an inheritance unto eternity,
because they are the exultation of my heart.
Inclinavi cor meum ad faciendas justificationes tuas in æternum,
I have inclined my heart to do your justifications for eternity,
and I have loved your law.
You are my helper and my supporter.
And I will examine the commandments of my God.
Uphold me according to your eloquence,
et non confundas me ab exspectatione mea.
And let me not be confounded in my expectation.
et meditabor in justificationibus tuis semper.
And I will meditate always on your justifications.
Sprevisti omnes discedentes a judiciis tuis,
You have despised all those who fell away from your judgments.
I have considered all the sinners of the earth to be transgressors.
Therefore, I have loved your testimonies.
Pierce my flesh with your fear,
for I am afraid of your judgments.
I have accomplished judgment and justice.
Do not hand me over to those who slander me.
Uphold your servant in what is good.
And do not allow the arrogant to slander me.
Oculi mei defecerunt in salutare tuum,
My eyes have failed in your salvation
and in the eloquence of your justice.
Fac cum servo tuo secundum misericordiam tuam,
Deal with your servant according to your mercy,
so that I may know your testimonies.
Ideo dilexi mandata tua super aurum
I have loved your commandments beyond gold and topaz.
Propterea ad omnia mandata tua dirigebar;
Because of this, I was directed toward all your commandments.
I held hatred for every iniquitous way.
ideo scrutata est ea anima mea.
Therefore, my soul has been examined by them.
The declaration of your words illuminates,
and it gives understanding to little ones.
according to the judgment of those who love your name.

Direct my steps according to your eloquence,
et non dominetur mei omnis injustitia.
and let no injustice rule over me.
Redime me a calumniis hominum ut custodiam mandata tua.
Redeem me from the slanders of men, so that I may keep your commandments.

Make your face shine upon your servant,

your testimonies and your truth even more so.

because my enemies have forgotten your words.

so that I may keep your commandments.
